usedFor: Shortcut holds epics and Slack is where the team talks, so “When a new epic is created” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new epic is created” in Shortcut, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: The team learns a new epic exists in the channel where they already talk.

watchOut: “When a new epic is created” is polling, so the Slack message follows a scheduled check.
